words: What you do in a complaint before any credit: explain luck, guide to the Jackpot, guide to the current activities.
The player's bonus budget. A complaint credit is sized at SW x 40% under the Compensation SOP.
The only way a complaint credit is given: first-level handling first, last-week P&L ladder at SW x 40%, one per week, ATL approval.
An abuse or fraud flag on the player. You check it in the profile before you commit anything.
The line you use when you cannot confirm something yet. It replaces a false commitment.
The Lark ticket query you use when compensation was issued.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Is this a complaint for this SOP?
items: The player is complaining on Livechat
It is about losing (a lot or a little) or asking for free credit
You have not replied with a solution yet
tour.done: All three: acknowledge the emotion first, then read the profile.
tour.notYet: This SOP covers losing-player and free-credit complaints on Livechat. Already replied? Still acknowledge the emotion before anything else.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Four steps, in this order
items: Acknowledge the emotion
Validate the feeling before any solution or redirect.
Read the profile
In the BO: losses, SW balance, recent credits, risk or abuse tag. Assess before committing anything.
Match the scenario
Respond per the scenario table. Any credit goes through the Compensation SOP.
Log the outcome
QA Record. Compensation issued: also a Lark ticket, query VVIP Complain player.

tour.label: Scenarios
tour.title: Three complaints, three responses
items: Losing a lot
"Saya nampak boss memang rugi sikit hari ni. Saya faham perasaan boss. Bagi saya check dulu ye." Do first-level handling. Keeps asking and stays upset: follow the Compensation SOP.
Losing little
Acknowledge: "Boss faham tu, memang kadang rasa macam tak kena." Then a game suggestion, then reframe toward hope. No credit committed.
Always asks for free credit
Decline gently: "Boss hari ni belum ada free credit lagi ye." Redirect to a game. Promise future notification by SMS.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Five hard stops
items: Jump to a solution before you acknowledge the emotion.
Promise a bonus you cannot deliver. Not sure? Say "let me check".
Give a credit outside the Compensation SOP.
Promise the credit before the ATL approves.
Give an SW credit the scenario or the remaining allowance does not permit.

tour.label: Approver
tour.title: Does this complaint get a credit?
tour.q: After first-level handling, does the player keep asking and stay upset?
tour.yes: Follow the Compensation SOP: last-week P&L ladder at SW x 40%, one per week, ATL approval. Promise nothing until the ATL approves.
tour.no: Validate the feeling and redirect. No credit.

pool.q: A VIP opens Livechat upset about a bad losing week. What does your first reply do?
o: Asks for his UID and SW balance
pool.why: Emotion first, solution second. Skipping the acknowledgement loses the relationship.

pool.q: Before you respond with anything, what do you check in the BO?
o: Losses, SW balance, recent credits and the risk or abuse tag
Nothing, go by how he sounds
pool.why: Step 2: read the profile and assess before committing anything.

pool.q: A player lost a small amount, not enough for an SW credit, and feels it is unfair. Best handling?
o: Promise a small credit to calm him
Acknowledge, suggest a fresh game, reframe toward hope
Tell him losses are normal and close
pool.why: Losing little: validate the feeling without committing a credit, offer a fresh game, reframe losses as timing.

pool.q: A player asks for free credit again. He has no qualifying condition. What do you do?
o: Give a small credit so he stays
Decline gently, redirect to a game, promise future notification by SMS
Tell him he asks too often
pool.why: Redirect without rejection. He should leave feeling looked after even without the credit.

pool.q: Big losses this week. You did first-level handling, but he keeps asking and is still upset. Next?
o: Promise RM 88 now and tell the ATL later
Follow the Compensation SOP; the ATL approves before any promise
pool.why: Losing a lot: follow the Compensation SOP. Never promise the credit before the ATL approves.

pool.q: The player asks you to confirm he will get a credit today. You do not know yet. What do you say?
pool.why: No false commitment. If unsure, say "let me check" first.

pool.q: What is first-level handling in a complaint?
o: Explain luck, guide to the Jackpot and the current activities
pool.why: First-level handling comes before any credit: luck, Jackpot, activities.

pool.q: Compensation was issued after ATL approval. What do you log?
o: QA Record and a Lark ticket, query VVIP Complain player
pool.why: Step 4: QA Record; if compensation was issued, also the Lark ticket.

pool.q: Under the Compensation SOP, what share of the SW is a complaint credit sized on?
pool.why: Golden Rules: last-week P&L ladder at SW x 40%.

pool.q: How often can a complaint credit be given to the same player?
pool.why: Golden Rules: a credit through the Compensation SOP is one per week.

pool.q: Mid-complaint, the player mentions his favourite hawker stall. How does the SOP treat this?
o: Listen and learn: it tells you about his preferences
Use it to end the chat faster
pool.why: Section 5: complaint moments are for listening; every complaint is data about the player's preferences and pain points.
